decision: Improvement not demonstrated. Both fully accepted pairs were slower for candidate; primary read-byte coverage incomplete. Lock failure retained and schema-only baseline failure distinguished. No attempts replaced.
limitations: Same-origin browser storage exposed prior recent-room references; authors did not open them.
Fresh task contexts included global instructions and task-creation metadata, not just the experiment packet.
Native metadata lacks a completeness signal; retained read output is partial or truncated.
Zero-count extra categories caused one exact-schema failure despite correct substantive inventory.
Small development pilot, two accepted matched pairs, no population-level claim.
publicProjection: Metrics diagnostic text is reduced to the first line; complete metric artifacts are private and identified by evidenceDigests.metricsFile.
